summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a Form 6-K on July 28, 2026, reporting changes in its Board of Directors. The filing announces the resignation of independent director José Fernando Sánchez-Junco after 17 years and the appointment of Sanjay E. Sarma as an independent non-executive director, recommended by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. Mr. Sarma brings expertise in technology and digital transformation from MIT and other ventures. No financial terms, shareholder vote, or strategic transaction are involved. This is a routine board composition change, not a special situation event.
